text: Civil engineering is a discipline that studies the planning, design, construction and maintenance of various engineering facilities (such as buildings, Bridges, roads, tunnels, water conservancy projects, etc.), aiming to cultivate professional talents with solid engineering theoretical foundations, practical abilities and innovative thinking. Students are required to master core knowledge such as engineering materials, structural analysis, and construction technology, and be capable of engaging in design, construction, management or research work in fields such as architecture, transportation, municipal engineering, and water conservancy.
